title: Deprecation cookbook and migration hub for legacy model versions
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Create an operational, self-serve deprecation workflow that combines automated customer notices, a Migration Hub in the Console, and a deprecation cookbook for engineering and support. This ticket scopes the PM deliverables: PRD for the Migration Hub, messaging cadence, telemetry requirements, and runbooks for greens/rollback. The intention is to reduce ad-hoc manual migrations, lower support volume during sunsets, and provide automated pinning and rollback assistance for customers who need stability.

Scope: (1) Migration Hub UI in Console with per-customer recommendations and one-click migration where safe; (2) Automated email/console notices with configurable windows and SDK warning flags; (3) A developer-facing deprecation cookbook (docs + migration recipes) with sample SDK code for pinning and fallback policies; (4) Telemetry signals and dashboards to detect migration friction and failed automatic migrations; (5) Operator runbooks for staged shutdown and final archival.

Constraints & trade-offs: One-click automated migration will only be enabled for compatible model pairs (same tokenizer, identical API surface) to avoid silent quality regressions. Full-fidelity A/B migration flows require engineering work in ENG-4123 (routing & rollout hooks). Prioritizing a strong, conservative automation reduces risk but increases manual steps for edge customers.

Success metrics: percent of customers migrated via Hub, reduction in support tickets for deprecation-related failures, time-to-migrate median, and incidents caused by model incompatibility. Telemetry: migration_attempts, migration_success_rate, migration_fallback_rate, migration_latency, and customer_comms_open_rate.
acceptance_criteria: Migration Hub MVP deployed to Console with customer-scoped recommendations and a dry-run preview
Automated deprecation notice cadence configured and sent for a pilot model with email + in-console alerts
Developer deprecation cookbook published with code samples for SDK warnings, pinning, and graceful fallback
Telemetry dashboards show migration_attempts and migration_success_rate for pilot customers
Operator runbook documented with staged cutoff windows and rollback checklist

implementation_notes: Use compatibility metadata fields: tokenizer_id, model_family, api_surface_hash, recommended_fallbacks
Migration Hub should surface a confidence metric and require human confirmation for 'Needs Review' cases
SDK teams should emit a 'deprecation_warning' event (non-fatal) which will be surfaced in the Console for customers still on deprecated versions
Plan a canary pilot with internal apps first to validate rollback behaviour before customer's one-click migration is enabled
risks_mitigation: Risk: Silent quality regression after automated migration. Mitigation: default to dry-run and surface sample side-by-side comparisons plus a 24h auto-rollback if error rate spikes.
Risk: Customers miss notices. Mitigation: multi-channel notices (email + in-console + SDK warnings) and an opt-in migration reminder flow.
Risk: Incomplete telemetry. Mitigation: instrument migration lifecycle events and require instrumentation as a gating criteria for Hub enablement
